content: Web3 frontend perf/a11y pitfalls: many small RPC calls per view increase perceived latency (batch via multicall to cut round trips up to 80%); large JS bundles (web3.js ~400KB min) hurt mobile 3G/4G load; wallet modal popups can block UI thread making app appear frozen if not handled async; screen-reader/keyboard-nav/color-contrast are frequently overlooked in dApp UIs, risking WCAG violations. Lazy-loading web3 libs cuts initial bundle 40-60%.
